Admission by reading (§3.4): a candidate is admitted when its sentence or paragraph makes a claim bearing on the CMS tracker (what it is, its cases, its scope, its operator, its limits, a measure taken on it) or on AI and copyright case trackers as a class to which the archive applies its own category; a bare mention, a link list, or a cms.law URL cited for another matter is not a claim on the entity.
